metadata.description: Parsers for hydra.core.model types, per docs/specification/syntax.md. The counterpart to hydra.core.print.model.

literal.string: Parse a term-level or type-level '@' annotation suffix
Parse a tightest-level term: any construct other than application, annotation, or type application
Parse a backtick-escaped name, applying the string-escape rules to its content
True iff the codepoint may appear in a bare name segment (alphanumeric, per syntax.md #2.4)
Parse a binder-head name: a single dot-free bare segment, or a backtick-escaped name
Parse a binding: name [':' '(' typeScheme ')'] ':=' term
Parse '{' ... '}' as a set or map term, disambiguating by a top-level '=' after the first element
Parse a case term: 'case' '(' name ')' termFields, splitting off a trailing '_' default field
Parse a type-class constraint: className typeVariable
Parse the digit string of a JSON-grammar number: sign, integer, optional fraction, optional exponent
Parse an either term: 'left' '(' term ')' or 'right' '(' term ')'
Parse exactly four hex digits as a 16-bit code unit
Parse a single hex digit character, yielding its numeric value (0-15)
Compute the numeric value of a hex digit character code (0-15), or Nothing if not a hex digit
invalid low surrogate in escaped surrogate pair
lone low surrogate in escape sequence
Parse a string-escape sequence after the backslash, combining surrogate pairs
Parse the ':width' suffix of a float literal and build its FloatValue from the preceding digits/sentinel
Parse an inject term: 'inject' '(' name ')' '{' name '=' term '}'
Parse the ':width' suffix of an integer literal and build its IntegerValue from the preceding digits
Parse a lambda term: 'λ' binderName [':' type] '.' term
Parse a let term: 'let' binding (',' binding)* 'in' term
Parse a token followed by optional trailing whitespace/comments
Parse a literal: boolean, numeric, string, or binary
Parse a literal-type keyword: binary, boolean, decimal, string, an integer width, or a float width
Parse a name: a greedily-read bare dotted name, or a backtick-escaped name
Parse a numeric literal: integer, float, or (unsuffixed) decimal
Parse an optional term: 'given' '(' term ')' or 'none'
Parse a complete term from a string, requiring the parse to consume all input
Parse a complete term signature from a string, requiring the parse to consume all input
Parse a complete type from a string, requiring the parse to consume all input
Parse a complete type scheme from a string, requiring the parse to consume all input
Parse an atomic term followed by zero or more postfix '@annotation'/'⟨type⟩' suffixes, left-chaining
Parse an atomic type followed by zero or more trailing '@annotation' suffixes
Parse a project term: 'project' '(' name ')' '{' name '}'
Parse a record term: 'record' '(' name ')' '{' [termField (',' termField)*] '}'
Parse an optional leading '-' followed by one or more decimal digits
Parse a full term: application of postfix-level terms
Parse a single term field: name '=' term
Parse a brace-delimited, comma-separated list of term fields (possibly empty)
Parse a specific keyword, followed by optional trailing whitespace/comments
Parse a term signature: '∀' [binderName (',' binderName)*] '.' [constraints '⇒'] arrow chain, with optional 'lazy' markers on parameter positions
Parse the arrow chain of a term signature, gathering (isLazy, type) parameter pairs alongside the final result type
Parse a term at postfix precedence (an atomic term plus its postfix suffixes)
Parse a type at function-arrow precedence (the full type grammar)
Parse a term-level type-application suffix: '⟨' type '⟩'
Parse a tightest-level type: any construct other than application, annotation, or function
Parse a function type: application-level type, optionally followed by '→' and a recursive right side
Parse a specific keyword, followed by optional trailing whitespace/comments (type-grammar alias of termKeyword)
Parse a type scheme: '∀' [binderName (',' binderName)*] '.' [constraints '⇒'] type
Parse one or more decimal digits
Skip zero or more whitespace characters and '#' line comments
Parse a wrap term: 'wrap' '(' name ')' '{' term '}'
